product.name: NiuLai Sanfang Qixiang City Walk Drink
core_selling_points: Fuzhou Sanfang Qixiang cultural landmark co-branding
Young, surreal, meme-friendly NiuLai Universe visual identity
Designed for short-video sharing and city-walk check-in moments

audience: 18-30 year-old young travelers, local city-walk users, and Douyin users interested in trendy cultural tourism
brand_tone: young, energetic, playful, culturally rooted, surreal but still tourism-friendly

must_show.packaging: A vertical slim can or bottle with Fuzhou Tourism x NiuLai co-branded packaging, visible in the final shot.
must_show.logo: Fuzhou Tourism logo and NiuLai Universe logo must appear clearly on the packaging or end card.
copy: Start now and meet NiuLai at Sanfang Qixiang

prohibited: Do not claim medical, health, weight-loss, or functional beverage benefits.
Do not imply official government endorsement beyond Fuzhou Tourism campaign branding.
Do not show distorted, unreadable, or fake-looking brand/logo text in close-up shots.
Do not use unsafe, violent, politically sensitive, or horror imagery.
Do not make Sanfang Qixiang look like a generic non-Chinese city street.
cta: Start now and meet NiuLai at Sanfang Qixiang
objective: Create a 15-second vertical Douyin demo ad that proves DreamPipe can turn a structured brief into storyboard, generation, QA, failed-shot retry, and final output.
constraints: MVP uses one product, three shots, one video model, and one CTA.
The demo must show input brief, storyboard, generation, QA, failed-shot retry, and final output.
At least one shot should intentionally fail QA first, then pass after prompt repair and retry.
Use the same project_id for project_bible.json, shots.json, and generation_result.json.
